title: Close dedicated legacy sales order mutation bypass through existing business policy
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Apply ERP404 finite sales-order mutation policy at this dedicated legacy endpoint before any SP call, default/number write or success response. Use live enabled identity and existing sales-order module authority, retaining server action/Oid identity. Reuse existing LegacyBillMutationRules rather than a second policy or business implementation. Without a safely verified canonical adapter and authoritative legacy-to-canonical mapping, return the same stable actionable business error; never infer Oid=Id, trust client header totals or silently convert unsupported request fields.

All five existing write actions must fail safely or call an already verified canonical business service with identical quantity/amount/source/downstream/state/transaction checks; no raw stored procedure mutation survives. Core canonical sales order and conversion workflows remain usable. Inspect/document actual dedicated-route callers and compatibility impact, preserve read/export/report endpoints until their own authorization/migration gates pass. No schema/SP/menu grants or production changes.

Meaningful unit and real isolated SQL controller tests cover all actions, live menu/disabled/revoked/foreign denial, forged old identifiers and monetary payloads, zero SP/business/detail/inventory/number changes, and existing canonical order creation/approval/cancellation regressions. Any safe adapter additionally requires canonical-versus-legacy races and rollback. Safe Release/full unit and accurate browser blockers.
